title: Dummies Will Resign!!
reviewNotes: Three short final-pattern comparisons only, beginning after Qxf4 at 75s in the seven-piece diagram White Kb3/Nc3/a5 versus Black Kc1/Qf4/f6/h7. Ne2+/Kd2/Nxf4 wins the queen and the exact six-piece ending. Independent a6 or Nb1 loses. Earlier larger queen/rook trades and Bg3/Bf4 bishop offer remain source context and are not certified by the final fork.
